newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures closing report.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures closing report.

text.p: Italian debt markets held in narrow ranges as they took their lead from international markets, awaiting key U.S. jobs data due out on Friday.
The March Btp future on LIFFE was around 17 basis points down at 130.38 after the cash market closed.

The November 2006 Btp ended 11 basis points up at 104.58, was yielding 7.20 percent and had a spread of 152 basis points over the 10-year benchmark Bund. The most traded July 2006 Btp was 13 basis points higher at 110.60.
The lira held its ground at 984.50, having also moved in a limited range between 980 and 985 in the course of the day.
